items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: He asked me about the Chick Webb things. I say, 'Well, you'll have to see Sally about the Chick Webb thing. I have nothing to do with that.' ... I think -- she says, 'I'm finished with this. It's all over. Don't bring me back'

ctx.x: Before the end of the war.

Yeah, before the end of the war. He died either after that. I can get you the date on that because (inaudible). I'll get you the date. But any -- See, I wanted to make a renewal. He asked me about the Chick Webb things. I say, "Well, you'll have to see Sally about the Chick Webb thing. I have nothing to do with that." He says, "Do you know where I" -- I say, "I can get a hold of her."
